name: TWL
recent: TWL Holdings 将于 2026 年 12 月 8 日召开特别股东大会，寻求股东批准追认向主席妻子 Datin Sek Chian Nee 授予的 ESOS 期权。近期董事及大股东 Dato' Tan Wei Lian 等人连续申报股权变动，同时公司因 RCULS 转换发行 154 万股新股，于 11 月 16 日上市。
notable: 将于 2026 年 12 月 8 日召开特别股东大会，寻求追认向 Datin Sek Chian Nee 授予的 6600 万股及 5370 万股 ESOS 期权。
因 RCULS 转换发行 154 万股新股，发行价每股 RM0.03，新股于 2026 年 11 月 16 日上市。
近期董事 Dato' Tan Wei Lian 及大股东 TWL Capital Berhad、Datin Sek Chian Nee 多次申报股权变动。
risks: ESOS 期权授予未经事先股东批准，需在特别股东大会追认。
RCULS 转换持续发行新股，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 62.69 million，环比增长 192.6%，同比增长 205.4%；净利为 MYR 1.831 million，环比下降 49.8%，同比下降 92.3%，净利率从上一季度的 17.0% 降至 2.9%。

recent_en: Recent filings show continuous changes in interests by director Dato' Tan Wei Lian and major shareholders, while 1.54 million new shares from RCULS conversion were listed on 16 Nov 2026.
notable_en: An EGM will be held on 8 Dec 2026 to seek ratification for 66 million and 53.7 million ESOS options granted to Datin Sek Chian Nee.
1.54 million new shares were issued from RCULS conversion at RM0.03 per share and listed on 16 Nov 2026.
Recent filings show multiple changes in interests by director Dato' Tan Wei Lian and major shareholders TWL Capital Berhad and Datin Sek Chian Nee.
risks_en: The ESOS grants were made without prior shareholder approval and require ratification at the EGM.
Ongoing new share issuance from RCULS conversion may dilute existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 62.69 million, up 192.6% QoQ and 205.4% YoY; net income was MYR 1.831 million, down 49.8% QoQ and 92.3% YoY, with net margin falling to 2.9% from 17.0% in the previous quarter.
